proposed: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
changes.evidence: In Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, Strange tells Earth-838's Mordo that killing their Stephen Strange was 'your ticket to getting the Sanctum, to becoming Sorcerer Supreme', and Mordo introduces himself as 'the Sorcerer Supreme' who replaced him; the memorial statue of their Strange stands outside the New York Sanctum. So the 838 Strange was a Master of the Mystic Arts (Sorcerer Supreme, master of the New York Sanctum): a past group told on screen, keyed to his first title and placed first. Marvel Database also lists Masters of the Mystic Arts for Stephen Strange (Earth-838).

changes.evidence: In Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, Mordo introduces her to the Illuminati's prisoner as 'Captain Carter: the first Avenger', which tells on screen that she was one of Earth-838's Avengers before the Illuminati. That's a past group, keyed to her first title and placed first. The MCU wiki and the Marvel Database both list the Earth-838 Avengers (now disbanded) among her groups.

Nicepool is a Deadpool variant banished to the Void in Deadpool & Wolverine, not a native of the main MCU (Earth-199999). The Marvel Database files him as 'Wade Wilson (Nicepool) (Earth-TRN872)'; its infobox gives his home Reality as 'Unknown', so TRN872 is the Marvel Database's own designation for him.

owner_calls.question: Should Earth-838's Black Bolt get a group for his kingship? Mordo introduces him as 'Blackagar Boltagon. Keeper of the Terrigen Mists. The Inhuman King.', but the screen never names a royal family or a kingdom (Attilan).
options: Add 'The Royal Family' (the dataset's name for the Inhumans' royals) keyed to Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, placed before The Illuminati
owner_calls.evidence: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness: Mordo's introduction calls him 'The Inhuman King'. The MCU wiki lists 'Inhuman Royal Family/Earth-838' as his affiliation, but that label isn't said in the film.

owner_calls.question: In X2, Kurt says he performed in a circus in Munich as 'The Incredible Nightcrawler'. That's a past employer told on screen, but the circus is never named. Should it be a group?
options: Add an unnamed circus stage (past group, keyed to X2, placed first) under a name the owner chooses
owner_calls.evidence: X2: Kurt tells Storm and Jean about his circus act in Munich. Tie-in material calls it the Szardos Traveling Circus, but only the prequel comic names it.
